items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the exterior power operations on finite locally free modules extend to maps on the Grothendieck group of vector bundles compatible with pullbacks (statement lines 4523-4530). The proof (proof lines 4531-4572) constructs a power series with coefficients the classes of exterior powers, proves its multiplicativity in short exact sequences using the induced filtration, and descends it to the Grothendieck group. H2: a complete standard construction in two steps.
